title: Averaged Walsh character identity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $a,b$ be elements of $(\mathbb F_2)^n$. With uniform expectations over $x,y\in(\mathbb F_2)^n$, the expectation of $\chi_a(x)\chi_{x+b}(y)$ over $x$ and $y$ equals the expectation over $x$ of $\chi_a(x)$ times the indicator that $x=b$, where $\chi_c$ denotes the Walsh character indexed by $c$.
